meta.title: DSH Toolbox
meta.description: Personal tool pack: two-layer memory injection + memory write tool, see_image (vision model transcription via host LLM channel), dispatch_plan/review/build/verify (the dispatcher split into four tools, each serving one fixed stage — 方案/门一/施工/门二; they assemble review-form combos and ready-made briefs per batch type, and the plan one emits the plan task book; rules live in JSON read fresh on every call; one exception: the enum in the parameter surface is a registration-time snapshot, so a new legal value needs a restart to enter that vocabulary), dispatch_batch (batch ledger with start/advance/status/list; state is folded from the events, the ledger lives in the machine-shared agent-data repo, and the four assembler tools back-fill that batch's decision list when given batch=), and dispatch_lessons (retro helper: reads the whole ledger and drafts pairing-rule revision suggestions once enough batches are logged — suggestions only, the main session decides and nothing is written back).
